text_blocks.snippet: Kidney cancer, specifically renal cell carcinoma, commonly metastasizes (spreads) to the following organs:

list.snippet: Lymph nodes: Regional lymph nodes near the kidney
Lungs: The most common site of metastasis
Bones: Particularly the spine, ribs, and pelvis
Liver: Can spread through the bloodstream or lymphatic system
Brain: Less common, but can occur
Adrenal glands: Located above the kidneys
Other organs: Rarely, kidney cancer can metastasize to other organs such as the skin, heart, or pancreas.

text_blocks.snippet: The specific sites of metastasis can vary depending on the type of kidney cancer, the stage of the disease, and the individual patient. It's important to note that not all patients with kidney cancer will develop metastases.
